principles: Never overwrite production sections in place.
Never delete current sections before progress mappings are validated.
Preserve current section IDs during staging and comparison.
Use deterministic canonical source keys as editorial references.
Use provisional reading-segment keys only after content boundaries are approved.
Block migration when a current section has no reliable canonical relationship.
Preserve completed progress conservatively when one current section becomes multiple successors.

completed_current_section_split_into_suc.proposed_rule: mark all verified successor segments complete only when the current section is proven to cover the complete successor range

incomplete_current_section_split_into_su.proposed_rule: resume at the first successor whose verified boundary contains or follows the current resume location
incomplete_current_section_split_into_su.otherwise: resume at the first successor and retain the original mapping for rollback

multiple_current_sections_merged_into_on.proposed_rule: mark the successor complete only when every contributing current section is complete

session_history.migration_behavior: retain original reading_sessions references and add a separate migration mapping when required
